02211101001222000211 - ASI: 16

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  02 = 0 * 2
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  20 = 2 * 0
  22 = 2 * 2
  100 = 1 * 00
  122 = 1 * 22
  211 = 2 * 11
  00211 = 00 * 211
  02211 = 02 * 211
  10100 = 10 * 100
  12220 = 122 * 20
  0221110100 = 02211 * 10100
  1222000211 = 12220 * 00211
  02211101001222000211 = 0221110100 * 1222000211
